---
name: Feature or UX suggestion
about: Suggest an improvement to gameplay, review, or mobile usability
title: "[Suggestion] "
---

### What would you like to do?
Describe your goal from a player's or spectator's point of view.

### What is difficult today?
Explain the current friction or missing behavior. Include the app version and device when relevant.

### Suggested change (optional)
Describe a possible interaction or layout, if you have one in mind.

### Context (optional)
Is this most relevant to Live, Spectate, Review, Hypothetical, History, Chat, or another screen?

Screenshots or sketches are welcome. Please avoid posting private account or game-chat information.
